results.segment: This notice concerns your policy renewal and is sent for information. No reply is needed.

obligations.deadline: at the end of the year

results.segment: If the account is in credit at the end of the year, request a refund in writing.
Where an interpreter is needed, book one at least a week beforehand.
Remember that passwords are never requested by this office.
Open an online account to check the balance at any time.
Amendments discussed by telephone were applied on 19 March.
